findings.title: Fragile patch path counting
findings.message: Distinct paths are counted from raw '+++ ' lines, which are not normalized. The same file can appear with a/ b/ prefixes in different patches, and added-content lines starting with '++ ' inside a patch file could be miscounted. Deleted files (+++ /dev/null) are skipped, so their targets are never counted, which understates affected_paths. The 'distinct paths' figure in the ADR and inventory is therefore unreliable.
findings.suggestion: Parse only 'diff --git' or '---'/'+++' header pairs outside hunks, and use the '---' path when '+++' is /dev/null. Strip a/ and b/ prefixes before adding to the set.
